name: flyby
description: Flyby — crowdsourced airport security checkpoint wait-time tracker

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/api && npm run build --workspace=packages/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/api && npm run test --workspace=packages/web && npm run test --workspace=packages/e2e
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=packages/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace=packages/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/api --if-present && npm run lint --workspace=packages/web --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/api && npx prisma migrate dev
